answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the quill queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1103 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the zenith. The terrace index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 31 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
